name: Hunter
lede: A unique design fusing cutting-edge aesthetics with innovative engineering, for an instantly recognisable, commanding stance.
body: Forget the standard fare — the Hunter comes from the fusion of cutting-edge aesthetics and innovative engineering, giving it an instantly recognizable and commanding stance. Its bold lines and aggressive profile aren't just for show; they reflect the forward-thinking electric performance beneath. This is a high-performance electric bike that delivers a massive jolt of torque and an unmissable statement of authority and style.
detail_intro: The EGO Hunter is engineered to dominate the street and rip up the rulebook. Hunter's compelling design is a guaranteed head-turner built for the daily ride. It pairs striking, modern elements with a balanced, intuitive feel, offering the perfect combination for riders of all levels.
motor: High-performance electric motor delivering instant torque and smooth acceleration. Compact, efficient, and brushless for low maintenance and maximum efficiency — durable and lightweight, built for high torque and long-range performance.
battery: A lithium battery is a lightweight, efficient rechargeable energy source built for electric vehicles. The Battery Management System (BMS) monitors voltage, current, and temperature for safe operation, preventing overcharging and thermal issues, which enhances performance and lifespan.
controller: A high-tech controller manages complex systems with cutting-edge algorithms and real-time monitoring, ensuring optimal performance, safety, and flexibility — enhancing reliability and efficiency with fast processing and improved connectivity.
charger: The Advanced Tec Charger provides efficient charging in a compact design, with safety mechanisms to prevent overheating and durability for long-lasting use — an energy-efficient design backed by a comprehensive warranty.
